purpose: Audit-only cable review overlay for the existing Moses-repair delivery. No model, electrical parameter, classification, operating input or previous map changed.

criteria.candidates: Exactly the40 current map parents categorized cable plus4 known cable-corridor/overhead-template conflicts. This is not a physical cable inventory.

statusLabels.classification_conflict: Cable evidence conflicts with overhead template

criteria.statusSemantics: The documented_cable_assumptions enum is a UI parameter-review category; use cableIdentity/evidenceTier for installation evidence. It does not itself certify a documented installed cable.
criteria.highPriority: Four documented classification conflicts, twelve imported345-kV cable/urban rows with current grossB >=10 times importedB, and three documented RCC feeders with assumed installed electrical/thermal parameters. The tenfold threshold is a transparent review triage threshold, not a physical invalidity test or a fit to observations.
criteria.reviewPriority: Remaining cable candidates are contextual evidence/identity reviews, not established defects.
criteria.activeFilter: At every map hour, match the current topology stateId and require parent.stateRecords[stateId].active. Do not display409 as active beforemay21 or410 as active beforemay30; inactive rows can remain explicitly listed as not yet active.
criteria.grossBGuard: The B ratios compare gross line charging only; separately modeled reactors and voltage squared behavior preclude calling this a netQ multiplier or a causal voltage explanation.

exclusions.scope: Controlled-transfer records: HTP, Neptune, CSC/1385, VFT and Ontario controls
exclusions.reason: They are not ordinary AC cable parent rows; no comparable conductor R/X/B is being audited here. Do not flag as a suspicious AC cable or double count physical merchant assets.

exclusions.scope: 65 composite voltage-changing equivalents; transformers and PAR records; reduced Y couplings; numerical section nodes
exclusions.reason: Voltage change, urban geography or mathematical coupling alone does not establish an underground cable or a bad cable parameter. These are excluded unless separately source-backed.
No new overhead misclassification is inferred from capacitance, proximity, map chords or model error. Only the four documented conflicts are included.
A review flag is not a claim the parameter is physically wrong, the line unsafe, or the actual facility overloaded; the frozen model remains unchanged.
